notice: Declarative, invented placeholders for offline review. Not production facts, limits, prices or approvals, and not executed by any acceptance engine. Map each scenario onto the accepted implementation's seams; a scenario the implementation cannot express is a review finding.

phases.P0: Operator side before the parent Invoke: approved bindings, parent client, owner decisions, worst-case sufficiency, exclusive operator claim.
phases.P1: Inside the function before each inner dispatch: actual inner clients and send gates, stage gates, per-attempt reservation.
phases.P2: Observations after dispatch: sends, retries, usage, results, REPORT, publication.

experiment_outcomes.STOP_BEFORE_DISPATCH: Stopped at P0; no outbound call of any kind.
experiment_outcomes.STOP_AT_STAGE: A gate stopped the run at stop_at; nothing after it may be sent.
experiment_outcomes.FAIL_RECORD_ONLY: All approved calls happened; a P2 observation fails acceptance.
experiment_outcomes.NOT_RAG_SUCCESS_RECORD_ONLY: Valid HTTP outcome that is not structural RAG success (AC-09).
experiment_outcomes.PASS_STRUCTURAL: Structural and numeric acceptance only (AC-09, AC-11). Requires EVIDENCE_COMPLETE_CONFIRMED.
experiment_outcomes.RESULT_NOT_ESTABLISHED: Evidence is incomplete, so no experiment result can be certified.

evidence_outcomes.EVIDENCE_COMPLETE_CONFIRMED: Every attempt, send, usage and stop published; returned status and matching evidence-index hash held. Independent of the experiment result.
evidence_outcomes.EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE: Partial, unconfirmed or missing publication or REPORT. Never reported complete, even if the answer looks successful.

usage.VALID: Built-in non-negative integers within bound, independently established for this request.
usage.VALID_OVER_BOUND: Independently established but exceeding the cap or bound.
usage.MALFORMED: Present but not a built-in non-negative integer.
usage.UNTRUSTED: Response rejected as a whole; usage not independently established.
usage.NONE: Not dispatched, or not a token-billed request.

treatments.NO_DISPATCH_THIS_ATTEMPT: This attempt sent nothing for the entry and took no new hold. Never releases, refunds or alters any other attempt's or run's hold.
treatments.SETTLE_ACTUAL: Approved request with VALID usage; settle at the bound rate.
treatments.RETAIN_FULL_RESERVATION: Approved request delivered or possibly delivered with usage not VALID; the full reservation stays charged as potentially billed.
treatments.RECORD_UNCLAMPED_OVERRUN: VALID_OVER_BOUND usage recorded exactly; abort latched.
treatments.RECORD_UNRESERVED_ACTUAL: Unapproved delivered request with known usage; recorded as its own unreserved exposure, never covered by another reservation and never authorized.
treatments.RECORD_UNRESERVED_EXPOSURE: Unapproved delivered model request with unknown usage; recorded as unknown, unbounded-by-reservation exposure.
treatments.INFRASTRUCTURE_ALLOWANCE: Non-model request (storage, logs); recorded against the infrastructure allowance, not a model reservation.

invented_baseline.question: What was invented-bank's total net revenue for fiscal year 2099?

scenarios.given: Route qa (0.92) with valid usage; both objects pass AC-03; valid 1024 unit vector with valid usage; five distinct in-range hits, finite non-increasing scores, two from expected_source; nonempty non-abstaining answer (operator-classified); all usage valid within caps; one send per request; evidence published and confirmed (returned status plus matching index hash).
The generation output cap is absent from the approved binding (only a proposed value exists).

Worst-case reservations for every approved inner attempt sum to 9.000000 units plus a 0.100000 infrastructure allowance; the approved task ceiling is 9.000000. Per-attempt checks inside the function would not cure this.
The operator's resolved parent invocation client shows total attempts 2 (or a retry mode allowing resends). A zero-retry observation from an earlier dry run is offered instead.
An exclusive claim for the same bound plan exists from an earlier crashed run whose parent Invoke outcome is unknown and which holds 9.000000 units. A new attempt is refused before dispatch.
The routing request was sent; a transport error follows; no response or usage. Production code would fall back to qa.
The routing response envelope is valid with independently valid usage; only its text is not the expected JSON object.
Route qa with confidence 0.55 (below 0.6); valid usage.
Route summarize with confidence 0.95; valid usage.
The first routing send was delivered and failed with a retryable error and no usage; the SDK attempted a second send, which the send gate blocked before delivery.
Conditional request and response identity match; index bytes have the exact approved size but a SHA-256 differing in one byte.
Both objects pass identity, size and hash; strict metadata parse finds a duplicate key in one row, or a NaN literal.
Identity, size and hash pass; one metadata row names s3://invented-bucket/private/invented-memo.pdf.
The conditional index read fails its IfMatch precondition (object changed), or times out with unknown completion.
Deserialized index reports dimension 768, or ntotal 11 against 12 metadata rows.
Embedding response has 1023 values; its usage field is present and independently valid (5 tokens, within bound).
The embedding response body contains a NaN token at position 7, so strict parsing rejects the whole body; no independently trustworthy usage can be established.
1024 finite values with L2 norm 0.5 although normalization was requested; usage present and independently valid.
Valid 1024 unit vector, but the input-token usage is absent, or -1, or 5.0, or true, or a string.
Search returns indices [3, -2, 0, 5, 1]; list indexing would silently map -2 to row 10.
Search returns indices [3, -1, 0, 12, 1]: a -1 sentinel and 12 equal to ntotal.
Five valid in-range hits, all from invented-bank-b and invented-bank-c; none from expected_source.
Search yields zero usable hits; the application path would return the no-evidence answer with HTTP 200. The stop and all prior usage are fully published and confirmed.
The generation request was delivered; the client read times out with no response.
Generation usage reports 260 output tokens against the invented cap 200; answer nonempty. The overrun is recorded unclamped and all evidence is published and confirmed.
Nonempty answer, but output-token usage is -3 (or a string, or 12.5).

Nested HTTP 200 with retrieved context; the answer is whitespace, or the operator, reviewing the privately retained answer under the approved disclosure, classifies it as a genuine abstention (recording the answer hash and classifier identity). No automatic judge.
Structurally valid run with confirmed evidence; the answer states an invented figure 101,000 while the recorded historical reference is 100,000.
Structurally valid run with confirmed evidence; the answer states exactly the recorded historical figure and lists retrieved sources.
Invoke reports a function error; REPORT shows max memory equal to the configured size after embedding settled and with generation delivery unknown. REPORT and journal are published and confirmed.
Structurally valid run with confirmed evidence; REPORT max memory 470 of 512 MB, init 3100 ms. The health-only figures were 155-156 MB and 2141.94 ms.
Invoke and nested HTTP 200 succeed and usage is valid, but the REPORT/INIT record cannot be retrieved.
The journal file is half-written when the disk fills; the evidence index either publishes without it or fails to close with parseable bytes on disk.
A generation error message embeds invented chunk text INVENTED-CHUNK-TEXT-7731 and an invented signed URL query X-Amz-Signature=invented; the sanitized stop is published and confirmed.
The operator aborts locally after the generation request was delivered and before any response arrives.
A request to an endpoint outside the approved set (for example the custom request-log API) is attempted; the send gate blocks it before delivery.
The parent Invoke times out client-side; whether the function ran, and which inner requests it delivered, is unknown.

The index GetObject request carried no IfMatch (and no VersionId although the binding has one); the returned bytes have the exact approved size and full SHA-256. Size and hash do not cure the missing condition.
The metadata response comes from a different bucket owner or key, or reports a different VersionId/ETag than approved, although its bytes are identical in size and SHA-256 to the approved object.

Send evidence shows two delivered routing sends. The first has unknown usage (full 3.000000 hold retained); the second returns valid usage worth 1.000000. Only one routing reservation (3.000000) was approved; recorded exposure is 4.000000.
After a qa route, send evidence shows a summarizer model request was delivered before generation; its usage is unknown. It is not part of GENERATE.
Send evidence shows a delivered custom request-log API call (an infrastructure request, not a model request).
Valid 1024 unit vector; the input-token count is 150 against the invented Titan bound 100.
Inside the function, the actually resolved inner Bedrock client shows total attempts 2 although the reviewed factory intended 1. Detected before its first request.
Every gate passed and a nonempty grounded-looking answer returned, but the evidence index failed to close: no returned confirmation and no matching index hash.

The index SHA-256 mismatches (stop before deserialization). The claim, every attempt, usage and the stop are published; returned status and matching index hash are held. Complete evidence of a failed experiment.
As S01, with every journal event, the Lambda REPORT and the returned status plus matching evidence-index hash confirmed.
